notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Easier Difficulty Mode & Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi Tacticians,[/p][p][/p][p]It's been 6 days since the 1.0 launch of Skygard Arena! [b]A huge thank you to everyone who jumped into the game[/b], whether you’re a new player or a returning veteran. [b]Seeing so many of you diving into Skygard Arena and loving it means the world to us.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve read every piece of your feedback, and [b]today we’re rolling out a small update to address some of the issues you’ve shared:[/b][/p][list][*][p]To make the single-player experience more accessible, [b]we are adding the possibility to play every campaign mission on an easier difficulty[/b]: in Story mode, all enemies will deal reduced damage.[/p][/*][*][p]We are [b]fixing a few bugs[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/2MBAbMMccM"]Discord server[/url] to share thoughts, hang out with the community, or just geek out over tactics. And if you’ve got a moment, a [b]Steam review[/b] would mean a ton, it helps us grow and improve![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and see you in the Arena![/p][p][/p][p]Team Gemelli[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]Full Patch Notes - Patch 1.0.4[/h1][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Campaign - Addition of Story Difficulty[/h2][hr][/hr][list][*][p]When playing the campaign, players can change the difficulty setting at anytime in the Settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]In Story mode, damage dealt by all enemies is reduced by 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]The difficulty in Regular mode is unchanged.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can switch between both difficulties at anytime, it will not affect their progression nor their achievements.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/f6b2886717333519629ee6c7ae8cbe717e167618.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause three Relics (Elvish Boots, Ultimate Dynamo and Angelic Convertor) not to work properly if both players were playing them in PvP mode.[/p][/*][*][p]When playing Champei Wind Avatar with Dissonant Armlet, the Critical token is now given instantly when an ally walks on a Gust Trap.[/p][/*][*][p]When Bu Shin recovers his movement action by using Smoke Bomb, this consequence is now properly written in the combat log.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the preview of an elimination, that would happen if the target had just respawned and Vallya had cast Guardian Angel while the target was dead.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause a black screen to appear while loading some scenes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/5dbd34014d4aabdb181cab0060fc8179eebb65a5.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.9.5 - New opening cinematic and much more!
notes.content: [p]Hello Tacticians![/p][p][/p][p]We are getting closer to the official release of Skygard Arena on September 18th! [/p][p]We just released a new update which further improves the game with:[/p][list][*][p]A new fully voiced opening cinematic[/p][/*][*][p]Steam achievements[/p][/*][*][p]German localization[/p][/*][*][p]Several adjustments to the difficulty of the campaign[/p][/*][*][p]The rework of a few Champions' spells[/p][/*][*][p]UX improvements and bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please find below the full patch notes. Also, if you have enjoyed playing the game so far, feel free to leave a positive review, it helps us a lot! ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][p][/p][p]The dev team at Gemelli Games[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]Patch notes - v0.9.5[/h1][p][/p][h2]New opening cinematic👀[/h2][p][/p][p]Let Na Jima tell you the origin story of Skygard, introduce you to its five factions and set the stakes before the Tournament begins![/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/P3DRsHHuarM"]Watch the new opening cinematic on Youtube.[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Achievements 🏆[/h2][p][/p][p]Complete 22 achievements across both Campaign and Arena modes! [/p][p]Will you manage to 100% the game?[/p][p][/p][h2]German Localization 🇩🇪[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Skygard Arena is now available in German![/b] Feel free to share your feedback regarding German localization [url="https://discord.gg/nfyDKT5bcM"]on Discord[/url] and we will review it promptly. [/p][p][/p][h2]Difficulty Adjustments - Campaign[/h2][p][/p][p][i]We have decided to [b]reduce the overall difficulty of the campaign[/b], to let as many players as possible progress through the story, play diverse missions and enjoy the game. [b]Players looking for some extra challenge can still try to achieve the secondary quests[/b], which are no easy feat![/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Mission #5[/u][/p][list][*][p]Enemy Champions' health points: 240 --> 200.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the starting position of one of the enemy Champions, making it easier to target them on round 1.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u]Mission #6[/u][/p][list][*][p]Boss' health points: 750 --> 660.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u]Mission #7[/u][/p][list][*][p]Changed the starting position of an enemy unit.[/p][/*][*][p]Number of ultimate charges on the map: 4 --> 5.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u]Mission #11[/u][/p][list][*][p]Removed one starting enemy unit.[/p][/*][*][p]All waves spawn one round later (on rounds 3, 5, 7, 9...).[/p][/*][*][p]The round limit for the Quest Blitz is now 10 rounds instead of 13.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u]Mission #12[/u][/p][list][*][p]Removed one enemy unit in each wave.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u]Mission #13[/u][/p][list][*][p]Guards' health points: 250 --> 200.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss' primary action damage: 40 --> 35.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss' secondary action damage: 25 --> 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Tokens applied by boss' secondary action: 2 Blind --> 1 Blind.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Changes to Champions' Spells[/h2][p][/p][h3]Aiden Inquisitor 🧙‍♂️[/h3][list][*][p]Smite (primary action): [b]extra damage per unique token on target = 15 --> 10.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Supreme Verdict (ultimate action): [b]no longer replaces positive tokens by their opposites. Now applies Lifedrain token.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]We are nerfing Aiden Inquisitor's damage on his primary action to bring it more in line with other primary actions. Also, the previous effect of Supreme Verdict would just nullify compositions which are based on using positive tokens, which was not healthy. He now applies one negative token which was not very present in the game, and synergises with his secondary and primary actions.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Vallya Commander 🏳️[/h3][list][*][p]With Me! (primary action): [b]Vallya now charges toward her target (1-3 range)[/b] before dealing damage and gaining 1 Impact token.[/p][/*][*][p]For the Kingdom (ultimate action): now [b]grants Besieger to all allies.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Vallya Commander was lacking tools to gap close enemies. Playing her should feel much better now![/i][/p][p][/p][h2]UX Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added a tooltip explaining how shield points work, which is automatically displayed when hovering on a spell or an item mentioning shields.[/p][/*][*][p]In mission #4, the mission description now displays the current wave and the total number of waves: 1/3, 2/3 or 3/3. [/p][/*][*][p]The correct character model for Vallya Commander is now used in the intro and outro scenes of mission #12.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the intro scene of mission #8.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the outro scenes of missions #7 and #10.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the display of damage preview on health bars.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that would delay the respawn of a Champion in PvP if the Champion playing just before the respawning Champion was eliminated during the respawn turn.[/p][/*][*][p]When capturing a Pillar, "0/0" is no longer displayed above the Pillar.[/p][/*][*][p]The Edit Team and Back buttons now work properly in Arena mode after clicking on Play again at the end of a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Using Drain Bot on a target with shield now properly grants shield points to the closest ally.[/p][/*][*][p]The current number of charges on Relics with charges (Next!, Inquisitorial Rosette and Ascending Bow) is now displayed properly. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: QoL Update - v0.9.4
notes.content: [p]Hello Tacticians![/p][p][/p][p]We just released a new update for Skygard Arena which includes several quality of life improvements and various bug fixes. This should make the whole game even clearer and your experience smoother![/p][p][/p][p]Also, the game is very close to reaching 50 reviews, which would unlock the "Very Positive" reviews tag! If you have enjoyed playing Skygard Arena, feel free to leave a review, it helps us a lot ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the update and see you in the Arena![/p][p][/p][p]The Gemelli Games team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]Patch Notes - Quality Of Life Update - v0.9.4[/h1][p][/p][h2]New QoL Feature: Combat Log! [/h2][list][*][p]We have added the combat log on the bottom right hand side of the screen during battles.[/p][/*][*][p]The combat log keeps track of all actions and interactions during battle: actions used, activation of a Relic's effect, movements, Pillar capture, ultimate charges gains...[/p][/*][*][p]You can scroll upwards while hovering on the combat log to review a previous event.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/9095b020c4410c8e531e0255bf5cf880317430f4.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]New QoL Feature: Quick Restart[/h2][list][*][p]During a Campaign mission, you can now press Escape and hit the Restart button to restart the mission with the same team directly. You no longer need to go back to a Camp and go through dialogues and the teambuilder screen. This should come in handy if you're looking to achieve a specific Quest and want to quickly retry a mission![/p][/*][*][p]Hitting the other button (Exit Mission) will now take you to the Campaign timeline instead of the Camp of the previous mission.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/ee79091fda7861dad116d9f717bc5eee9991d0fb.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2]General User Experience Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Reduced the delay between the start of the round and the start of the turn of the first Champion to play in several missions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause AI units to slide through the Arena instead of running if they took damage from Poison tokens before moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would show Pillar Capture and Pillar Teleportation buttons before the actual start of a Champion's turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Angelic Convertor relic that was carried by Seraphine during mission #3 but did not work properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Spell descriptions in the teambuilder can no longer overflow out of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when leaving the camp through the Escape/ Settings menu. Doing so now takes you to the home screen as intended.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2 - Difficulty adjustment & UX improvements
notes.content: [p]Dear Tacticians,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to all of you who recently purchased the game and tried it for the first time! We read your feedback and decided to release a small update to fix some issues and improve the experience as soon as possible.[/p][p][i]Patch notes v0.9.2:[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Lowered difficulty[/b] of missions #1 and #2 by reducing health points of several enemy units.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that triggered a dialogue under the wrong circumstances in mission #2.[/p][/*][*][p]In the campaign timeline, quests are no longer visible below the narrative description of a mission until you have completed that mission for the first time. Also, if you have been enjoying the game, feel free to leave a review on Steam, it helps us a lot! ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][p][/p][p]Gemelli Games[/p]

notes.title: Major Update 0.9 - Localization & Relics!
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Tacticians![/p][p][/p][p]We just released a new Major Update for Skygard Arena. The game is [b]now available in Simplified Chinese, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The update also includes performance optimizations, changes to some of the Champions’ Relics and Spells as well as some UX improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the update and see you in the Arena![/p][p][/p][p]The Skygard Arena dev team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]Patch notes - v0.9 Major Update[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Localization[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Skygard Arena is now available in Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Optimizations[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Cleaned several assets in the game, which reduces GPU VRAM usage in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lighting and other visual elements in the Crystal arena and the various Guardians arenas, which greatly improves FPS when playing in these arenas in High quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the performance settings for the Low, Medium and High quality options.[/p][/*][*][p]When launching the game for the first time, the game will now check your PC setup and choose the most appropriate quality setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added FPS targets for each option (when VSync is disabled).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Changes to Combat System (tokens)[/b][/h2][list][*][p]For clarity and consistency purposes, Bleed tokens are no longer considered the opposite of Regeneration tokens. Only Poison tokens are the opposite of Regeneration tokens.[/p][/*][*][p]Impact tokens now apply to every target hit instead of the first target only. This applies to AoE spells and targets with the Bond status.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Changes to Relics & Champions[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][u]Raine - Poison Witch[/u][/p][list][*][p]Creeping Thorns (Primary): damage increased from 30 → 35.[/p][/*][*][p]Deadly Harvest (Ultimate): damage increased from 30 → 35.[/p][/*][*][p]Scepter of Mithridate (Reworked): Whenever an enemy consumes a Poison token, Raine heals for 15 health points.[/p][/*][*][p]Armlet of Haste → Reaper’s Gem (New): damage dealt by Deadly Harvest (ultimate action) to enemies are increased by 10 for each Poison token on them.[/p][/*][*][p]Cobra Staff (Buffed): the effect now applies to every member of Raine’s team.[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed Censer (Reworked): when an enemy with a Poison token moves or is moved, they become Infected for 1 turn.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Raine Poison Witch was pretty underwhelming, so we are reworking / buffing all her Relics and buffing her ultimate spell. These relics should offer 4 different playstyles, enabling you to choose her role between a self-sustaining mid-distance mage, a high-damage mage relying on her ultimate, a Bleed/Poison comp enabler and a pure damage comp amplifier![/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Raine - Life Mage[/u][/p][list][*][p]Scepter of Vitality (Nerfed): +10% → +8% damage per Regeneration token.[/p][/*][*][p]Rejuvenating Staff → Vision Staff (New): Whenever an ally of Raine is healed above their maximum health points, this ally gains 1 Vision token.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Stacking Regen tokens with Scepter of Vitality and dealing massive damage is fun, but it seems slightly overtuned at the moment, so we are bringing it down a notch. We are also bringing another source of Vision tokens to the game.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Aiden - Archbishop[/u][/p][list][*][p]Tome of Sight (Reworked): At the end of his turn, Aiden and his allies in a 3-cell radius around him gain 1 Sight token.[/p][/*][*][p]Tome of Purity (Reworked): Each member of Aiden's team deals 20% more damage when they have all their health points.[/p][/*][*][p]Tome of Alacrity → Clear Bell (New): At the end of Aiden's turn, applies a Positive Resonance to the closest ally.[/p][/*][*][p]Tome of Rejuvenation (Reworked): Whenever a member of Aiden's team receives healing, its value is increased by +5 per unique kind of token on him.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Aiden Archbishop’s relics were not exciting enough, so we are reworking all of them and offering 4 unique distinct playstyles.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Aiden - Inquisitor[/u][/p][list][*][p]Clear Bell → Tome of Omnipotence (New): Supreme Verdict also hits enemy Pillars.[/p][/*][*][p]Lunairomicon (Reworked): Whenever a member of Aiden's team applies a stackable negative token, applies once more the same token type.[/p][/*][*][p]The Lunairomicon is now given as a reward after completing mission 12 in the campaign.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Picking the new Tome of Omnipotence solves one of Aiden’s big weakness: his lack of damage against Pillars. And we hope to see some crazy negative tokens combo comps with the reworked Lunairomicon![/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Bu Shin - Shadow Assassin[/u][/p][list][*][p]Throwing Dagger is now called Sharp Eye.[/p][/*][*][p]Infiltrator’s Mask (Reworked): Enemy units receive 40% increased damage if they have a Blind token on them.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]The reworked Infiltrator’s Mask increases Bu Shin damage and kill potential and synergises well with other Champions like Aerica.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Vallya - Vanguard Persona[/u][/p][list][*][p]Guardian's Resolve (reworked): Allies in the area of effect of Sacred Bulwark also gain Haste and Impact.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]The previous iteration boosted Vallya’s ultimate, which is already super strong. We are shifting some power towards her secondaries with this relic. She can become a reliable source of positive tokens for a hypercarry like Bu Shin![/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]User Experience Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]When launching the game for the first time, your system language will be detected automatically and the game's language will adapt accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Back and Home buttons to some screens in the lobby of the Arena mode where they were missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Merged the Play and Teams buttons in the lobby of the Arena mode. Clicking on Play now enables you to select ax existing team or to create one, before choosing your game mode and launching a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a clear description to the Protections keyword.[/p][/*][*][p]When Aerica uses her beacon to teleport, you will now see the visual effect and hear the sound effect of Teleportation.[/p][/*][*][p]The dialogue explaining that capturing a Pillar grants 1 ultimate charge now appears in mission #2 instead of mission #3.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update #12
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Tacticians![/p][p][/p][p]Skygard Arena just received its 12th update since the start of Early Access![/p][p][/p][p]This update brings lots of general user experience improvements, some performance optimization, several balancing changes for Raine, Aiden, Bu Shin and Aerica, and a bunch of bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the new patch and see you in the Arena![/p][p][/p][p]The Skygard Arena Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]PATCH NOTES - v0.8.2[/h1][p][/p][h2]General User Experience Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Optimized the game to reduce vRAM usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sound effect when selecting a Relic in the Champion editor.[/p][/*][*][p]In Relics’ descriptions, improved the font colour of the ultimate action when it is referenced.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the speed of the camera rotation when rotating the camera with the mouse wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved and clarified the description of several Spells and Tokens.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visuals for the Champions’ portraits in the teambuilder.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/1d3828cffa5aba2f579d9f52ffa8bae0fb7a0a90.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Improvements to the Single-Player Campaign[/h2][list][*][p]Improved the intro dialogues of mission 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Once you have gone through the teambuilder tutorial before mission 3 once, this tutorial will no longer appear when launching mission 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tutorial dialogue about Teleporting between Ally Pillars in mission 3.[/p][/*][*][p]The model of Na Jima Skirmisher persona is now used in the Camp through Act 2 of the Campaign.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the intro and outro scenes in mission 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause weird UI elements to appear on the loading screen of campaign missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the description of a couple of Quests which were using “turns” instead of “rounds” and conversely.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-balanced the volume of the music in intro scenes, the teambuilder and outro scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]On the Rewards screen, when you unlock a Persona, the first Relic unlocked with this Persona now appears immediately below the Persona.[/p][/*][*][p]When you complete a mission for the first time, you will now see an animation with a moving golden start next to the Quests button to let you know that you can pick up stars in the Quests section.[/p][/*][*][p]In the teambuilder of a campaign mission and during dialogue scenes, clicking on Quit in the options menu will now properly lead you to the Home screen instead of closing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the user experience when coming back into the game to play the Campaign mode.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]System Changes[/h2][list][*][p]When an action both consumes and applies tokens, consumption happens first and application happens second.[/p][list][*][p]Example: using Earth Squash with Champei equipped with Resonant Gong on a target who already has an Exposed token will consume the Exposed token, increase damage dealt and then apply another Exposed token.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Impact[/b] tokens now deal [b]regular damage instead of pure damage.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the damage formula, which is now:[/p][list][*][p]\[Spell base damage x Attacker Damage Multiplier [i](Critical Strike, Dazed token, any relic boosting spell damage…)[/i] + Additional Flat Damage [i](from Impact tokens)[/i]] x Defender Damage Multiplier [i](from Exposed token, Barrier token…)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]In particular, Impact tokens are now affected by both Exposed and Barrier.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dealing damage with Aerica's sentry is now counted as a separate effect. In particular, using Switcheroo on a Champion to displace them into the sentry's surveillance line now first consumes the Barrier token with Switcheroo and then applies the full damage from the sentry's surveillance attack.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balancing & gameplay changes for Champions[/h2][p][u]Aiden - Inquisitor Persona[/u][/p][list][*][p]Word of Penance (secondary) : this action no longer has a different effect on allies and enemies. The effect is now: Deals 25 damage and applies 3 Regeneration tokens to target.[/p][/*][*][p]Inquisition (secondary): can be cast on an enemy holding [b]any token[/b] → can be cast on an enemy holding [b]a negative token.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Inquisitorial Rosette (Relic): [b]+15% → +10% damage per charge.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Aiden Inquisitor could feel oppressive to play against with few options to counter him. We are reducing his scaling power so that he does not one-shot enemy Champions too early in the game. We are tweaking his teleport ability so that he won't be able to jump on your carry as long as you they don't have negative tokens on them.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Raine - Life Mage Persona[/u][/p][list][*][p]Renewal (secondary) : can no longer be cast on enemies. Applies Unhealable for [b]3[/b] rounds instead of 2. Still heals by 50 HPs.[/p][/*][*][p]Twin Roses (ultimate): [b]ultimate charges cost = 6 → 8.[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Bond effect no longer copies Statuses, except when it’s clearly stated otherwise (for only one status at the moment: unhealable).[/p][/*][*][p]The color of the Bond VFX is now Blue if it was applied by one member of your team, and Red if it was applied by a member of the enemy team. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Sceptre of Overheal (Relic) → Sceptre of Vitality (new Relic):[/b] Damage dealt by the spells of each Champion on Raine's team are increased by 10% for each Regeneration token on them.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]The downside from using Renewal and healing for 50 HPs was too small, especially when used on Raine, so we are increasing the duration of Unhealable. We don't think it was healthy that Raine could easily counter a composition relying on healing, so we removed her ability to target enemies with Renewal.[/i][/p][p][i]Twin Roses is one of the most interesting and powerful ultimate actions of the game: we are aligning its cost with its power.[/i][/p][p][i]Sceptre of Overheal was causing many balancing issues, especially combined with Aerica Artificer. Teams could generate an insane amount of ultimate charges and shield points (with no real counterplay), which resulted in frustrating matches. We looked at different options and decided to change the Relic for a new one, which brings a new scaling option and synergies with other Champions who can apply Regeneration tokens.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Bu Shin - Shadow Assassin Persona[/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Shadow Trap (secondary) - Reworked:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Summons a Shadow on target cell.[/p][/*][*][p]At the start of his next turn, Bu Shin teleports on the Shadow.[/p][/*][*][p]If a unit steps on the Shadow, it is destroyed. When the Shadow is destroyed, Bu Shin gains Impact 2.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Smoke Bomb (secondary): token applied to enemies: [b]2 Blind tokens → 1 Blind token[/b]. He still gains 1 Impact token for each enemy hit and regains his movement action.[/p][/*][*][p]Tormentor (Relic) → [b]Looter Dagger (new Relic): When Bu Shin slays an enemy Champion, he gains 3 ultimate charges and 1 Impact token.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Night Fang (Relic): now increases by 30% both damage from Bu Shin's spells and [b]Bu Shin's Impact tokens[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Bu Shin Shadow was not quite fulfilling his fantasy as an assassin who can go in, get a kill, go out. Shadow Trap was also quite complex to grasp with multiple effects. So we are simplifying this secondary action and turning it into a reliable tool to teleport and generate Impact tokens. [/i][/p][p][i]The Tormentor Relic (which applied Poison and Bleed tokens) did not fit with the assassin, bursty fantasy of this Persona. The new Looter Dagger Relic rewards Bu Shin for getting kills and should make him more reliable in the mid-game, after getting his first kill.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Aerica - Artificer Persona[/u][/p][list][*][p]Elvish Boots (relic): Whenever Aerica or an ally teleports through a Pillar or the Relay Beacon they also gain [b]3 → 2 ultimate charges.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Teams using this Relic could generate an absurd number of ultimate charges by teleporting and gain a massive advantage in the early game. We believe the Relic is still powerful and playable with 2 charges per teleport.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]Daerio - Duelist Persona[/u][/p][list][*][p]Final Hour (relic): Daerio's ultimate action slays the enemy target -> deals 9,999 pure damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]The goal of this change is to clarify which is stronger between Final Hour and the Undying status: Final Hour does not enable to kill a target who has the Undying status.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented Daerio from capturing a Pillar with his refunded Primary Action after eliminating an enemy with his primary action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented a Champion from fully disappearing when eliminated by Daerio Duelist equipped with Final Hour.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause the game to soft-lock when playing against the Experimental AI, if the AI was considering using the Teleport action or Champei’s Switcheroo action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when using Bond against the Experimental AI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause ultimate orbs not to respawn if Aerica, Champei or Bu Shin were being played.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could prevent your team from spawning at the start of a PvE mission in certain circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ascending Bow relic now properly shows up as a relic which influences Na Jima's primary action and ultimate action when you hover on one of these actions.[/p][/*][*][p]When Vallya Vanguard is equipped with Judgement Hammer, the prompt correctly says Choose a Champion instead of Choose an Ally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented the camera from moving when using the mouse while auto-focus was on.[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering on the Night Fang Relic (Bu Shin Shadow) no longer shows the tooltip for Impact tokens.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would delay the update of the spells’ description when changing Personas quickly in the teambuilder.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause a zone on the right-hand side on the screen to be unclickabke during battle.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Quests Major Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Tacticians!  [/p][p][/p][p]We just released a new Major Update, which brings a lot of replayability to the single-player campaign with the addition of Quests! Quests are new optional challenges specific to each mission.  [/p][p][/p][p]In addition, this update significantly improves the flow and the user experience in the campaign. We also made some gameplay and balancing changes to four of the late game missions and to a few Champions & Relics.  [/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy this new content! If so, please consider leaving a review as it helps us a lot with visibility ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the Arena,  [/p][p]The Skygard Arena Dev Team  [/p][p]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  [/p][h1]Patch notes - v0.8 - Quests Major Update

[/h1][h2]NEW FEATURE: QUESTS[/h2][list][*][p]In the single-player campaign, each mission now features two optional quests. To complete a quest, you’ll have to win the mission while meeting an additional condition / achieving an additional challenge.  [/p][/*][*][p]Examples of quests include playing a specific Champion, completing a mission before a certain turn limit, not losing a single Champion, not taking any damage on your Pillars… and much more! The full list of quests can be found below.  [/p][/*][*][p]The timeline of the Campaign now shows a tracker of your global progression, with 39 stars to collect (13 by completing missions and 26 by completing optional quests). [/p][/*][*][p]When selecting a mission, now you’ll be seeing the context of the mission and what you need to achieve to complete the optional quests.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/a6e9e1c89dd799cf3d53fa1717b050572457e9da.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]During a mission, you can see on the right-hand side of the screen (i) the goal of the mission and (ii) what you need to achieve to complete the optional quests.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/195fe9e4318d85e13d363eab21685304b0e85a87.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]We have designed most quests to be pretty challenging! Many of them will most likely require you to adapt your playstyle, build a specific team and experiment with new synergies. Some of them might seem impossible at first… but where there is a will, there is a way!   [/p][/*][*][p]The full list of quests can be found [url="https://discord.com/channels/1036680078219821146/1247469747856085073/1385184069176004699"]here[/url]. [b]Will you manage to complete all of them and gather all 39 golden stars? [/b]  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]USER EXPERIENCE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][list][*][p]Dialogue scenes can now be skipped. [/p][/*][*][p]The flow in the campaign is now [b]Introduction Dialogues -> Teambuilder -> Mission (Combat)[/b]. The teambuilder used to be before the intro dialogues, which resulted in a weird experience: players had to build a team without being given any narrative context nor gameplay information about the mission, so we fixed this. [/p][/*][*][p]The Teambuilder got a nice upgrade and now provides gameplay information about the mission that you’re about to play: overview of the Arena, win condition, lose condition and what you need to achieve to complete quests!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/542ab783c863faae4b3b9700c49baf16d9eab973.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The end game screen now has a Quests section which summarizes which quests have been completed.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/816cec35a7eea27699189c96371a5951a5e2162a.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]CAMPAIGN MISSIONS: GAMEPLAY AND BALANCING CHANGES[/h2][p] [/p][h3]Mission #10 [i]Saving Archbishop Aiden[/i][/h3][list][*][p]Added 3 enemy units to increase the mission’s difficulty.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Mission #11 [i]Enemies for Life[/i][/h3][list][*][p]Removed many starting units. [/p][/*][*][p]New: at the start of every even round (rounds 2, 4, 6, 8…), 1 enemy unit spawns from each Major Pillar controlled by the enemy team. These units spawn in Passive status and can become Alerted. The enemy units are Mage, Soldier, Archer and Captain in this order. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked lose condition: [strike]The Silver Kingdom army is entirely defeated [/strike]→ All of your 3 Champions are eliminated.   

[/p][/*][/list][p][i]We think these changes will bring the following benefits: [/i][/p][list][*][p][i]You will spend less time watching AIs play their turn and more time playing your Champions; [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The mission will feel less like a challenge to protect your ally units, and more like a race to capture the enemy pillars before the enemy army becomes overwhelming. [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The difficulty of the mission should feel more even across rounds, as facing the starting enemy army becomes less daunting but new units come in to replace defeated units.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Mission #12 [i]In Front of the Palace[/i][/h3][list][*][p]Removed an enemy unit that spawned with wave 2.  [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted wave timing: the wave of enemies spawning at the bottom of the Arena now spawns in 3rd instead of 4th, which should give them time to reach the center of the battlefield and have an impact on the fight.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Mission #13 [i] Clair Obscur[/i][/h3][list][*][p]Added a clear description of the relic Angelic Aegis (equipped on each Guard):[/p][p]-- Damage dealt to Guards change based on the number of Pillars under your control.[/p][p]-- 0 Pillar: 100% damage reduction.[/p][p]-- 1 Pillar: 50% damage reduction.[/p][p]-- 2 Pillars: neutral.[/p][p]-- 3 Pillars: 50% damage increase.[/p][p]-- 4 Pillars: 100% damage increase.[/p][p]-- 5 Pillars: 150% damage increase.[/p][p]-- Pure damage ignore the modifier. [/p][/*][*][p]Clarified the description of the Sinsears’ Crown Relic:[/p][p]-- At the start of each turn, one Guard is designated as Sacrificed.  [/p][p]-- When the final boss is attacked, the Sacrificed Guard receives all damage in their place. [/p][p]-- If the Sacrificed Guard is defeated, another Guard is immediately Sacrificed. [/p][p]-- Each time a Guard is eliminated, the Crown gains one charge. The final boss deals 25% more damage per charge (Current bonus : +X%)  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the hitbox icon of several spells of the final boss. [/p][/*][*][p]The sacrifice of Guards now properly works when Daerio Duelist equipped with Final Hour casts his ultimate action Katia's Judgment: the final boss now longer dies, the Guard who is sacrificed now dies instead, as intended. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Personas & Relics Unlock Order[/h3][list][*][p]We made a few changes to the order in which you unlock Personas and Relics through the Campaign. In particular, you will unlock Relics which synergize well together at the same time more often. Overall, you will also unlock more Relics, which mean more potential playstyles, especially in the late game.    [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]CHAMPIONS: GAMEPLAY AND BALANCING CHANGES[/h2][p] [/p][h3]Vallya - Commander Persona [/h3][p][i]We are changing her primary action, which was too clunky and was not providing a reliable source of damage. We also add a reliable source of Impact tokens, something that was missing in the pool of Champions’ actions. Finally, we enable her to cast her ultimate action more often.[/i] [/p][list][*][p]Her Primary Action [i]Charge! [/i]is replaced by [i]With Me![/i] [/p][p]-- 1-1 range.[/p][p]-- Deals 40 damage to target enemy.[/p][p]-- Vallya and her allies around her gain an Impact token.  [/p][p]-- Critical Strike: +50% damage.  [/p][/*][*][p]For the Kingdom (Ultimate Action): [/p][p]-- Ultimate charges cost: 7 → 6.  [/p][p]-- Area of Effect : 5-cell radius → 6-cell radius.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Champei - Earth Avatar Persona[/h3][list][*][p]The Relic Shocking Gong is now called Speed Gong for the sake of clarity.

[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bu Shin - Shadow Assassin Persona[/h3][list][*][p]Night Fang (Relic - reworked): Bu Shin deals 30% more damage as long as his target has more health points than him. [/p][/*][/list][p][i]The previous version did not let players play around the various positive tokens and reduced the diversity of potential synergies and situations. With this reworked Relic, we provide a tool to maximize Bu Shin's damage against high-HP units and when he's close to dying.  [/i] [/p][p][/p][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][list][*][p]Changed camera settings in order to fix a bug which would prevent players from controlling the camera and would make the camera drift towards the top left corner. [/p][/*][*][p]The VFX of Constellation (Na Jima Skirmisher's Ultimate action) is now properly displayed.  [/p][/*][/list]

Enjoy and see you in the Arena!

Team Gemelli

[list]
[*] Made it easier to scroll through the rewards received after a mission in the campaign.

[*] Fixed a bug with Galeblade that prevented Champions from benefitting from its effect if they already had a Haste token on them.
[*] Fixed bugs that could create incorrect interactions between Blind and Sight tokens.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused incorrect data to appear on the end game screen in Arena mode.
[*] Fixed a bug which delayed the visual feedback associated with gaining ultimate charges when certain Champions would pick up two ultimate orbs in the same movement action. 
[/list]

notes.title: Community Tournament, Eastern Games Festival & Special Discount!
notes.content:
The Arena is calling for you, Tacticians!

We have some exciting news, with the return of the Arena Kings community tournament this weekend, a Steam festival and a time-limited discount.

[h1]Second edition of Arena Kings![/h1]

We are delighted to be organizing the second edition of the Arena Kings community tournament. 
Join the competition to showcase your Tactician's skills and your original builds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/ee61376a87b1fb2c4581506f9a336dda68bcbc57.png[/img]

[h3]Format[/h3]

The Arena Kings tournament will be split in 2 phases: Swiss Stage & Playoffs.

[b]Swiss Stage[/b]
[list]
[*] All participants will play 5 Bo1 matches in a Swiss Stage format. Each victory brings 1 point and each draw brings 0.5 points.
[*] At the end of the Swiss stage, the 4 best ranked players will qualify for the playoffs, that will take place the next day.
[/list]
[b]Playoffs[/b]
[list]
[*] The top 4 players will compete in a single-elimination bracket, with semi-finals and finals.
[*] All matches will be played in Best of 3 format: the first player to reach 2 victories wins.
[/list]
[u]New rule: Fearless Relic Draft during Playoffs![/u]

To increase the diversity of team composition and reward players mastering multiple playstyles, we are introducing a new rule for Playoffs: Fearless Relic Draft!

This rule is simple: each player can only play a given Relic once during a Bo3 match.

[i]For instance, if a player plays Venomous Heart with Jorn Predator during game 1, this player not play Venomous Heart again during game 2 and game 3. This player is allowed to play Jorn Predator equipped with another Relic.
Their opponent is allowed to play Venomous Heart once during the Bo3 as well.
This player will be able to play Jorn Predator with Venomous Heart once again during the next match.
Fearless Relic Draft does not apply during the Swiss Stage.[/i]

[h3]Dates & Times[/h3]
The tournament will take place on April Saturday 26th and Sunday 27th:
[list]
[*] Swiss stage will take place on Saturday 26th, starting at 3pm CET
[*] Playoffs for the top 4 players from the swiss stage will be played on Sunday 27th, starting at 3pm CET
[/list]
[h3]Prizes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The winner of the Tournament will receive an exclusive Discord title, as well as 2 Steam keys to share the game with their friends!
[*] The runner-up will also receive one Steam key to gift Skygard Arena to a friend.
[*] All participants will get a special [i]Arena Kings Contender[/i]Discord title!
[/list]
[h3]How to register for the Tournament[/h3]
Sign up easily on the [url=https://challonge.com/fr/e8keztg2]Challonge page of Arena Kings II[/url].
Join [url=https://discord.gg/y6vujzZmGd]our Discord server[/url] to receive the latest info and meet the other participants! 


[h1]Eastern Games Festival[/h1]

Skygard Arena is part of the Eastern Games Festival on Steam from April 23rd until May 2nd!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/2dbc09f58f93ffe4db9355c6b6f62c7c43f3a4c7.png[/img]

Asian cultures have been a major source of inspiration for certain Champions of Skygard and we are thrilled to be part of this major showcase!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/251df17e8680fde2eabbc4c3abd53db3982d34ee.gif[/img]

[h1]Time-limited 20% discount![/h1]

As part of the Eastern Games Festival, [b]you can purchase Skygard Arena at a 20% discount before May 2nd! [/b]

We recently released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2148970/view/520837042930712639?snr=1_5_9_]the Progression and Relics update[/url], the 9th early access update for Skygard Arena. Now, players have access to all Champions, Personas and Relics upfront in Arena mode and are free to build their own team and play it in matches against other players or the AI. No need to unlock anything, you can start experimenting with different team compositions and synergies right away! 
We have also added 3 pre-built teams for players who want to jump into a game with an easy-to-use and efficient team composition. [b]With these recent improvements, there has a never been a better time to play Skygard Arena![/b]

Alex from Gemelli Games

notes.title: The Progression & Relics Update is live!
notes.content:
Dear Tacticians,

We just released the 9th Early Access update for Skygard Arena, with some pretty big changes! 

Full patch notes below - here is the TL; DR:
[list]
[*] Artifacts are now called Relics!
[*] [b]All players now have access to all Champions, Personas and Relics upfront in Arena mode![/b] No need to spend time unlocking everything before creating mind-blowing team comps.
[*] We reviewed many Relics and implemented some pretty big changes, enabling new potential playstyles for Champions and new team synergies. Ready to play Jorn Juggernaut, Na Jima Cannon or Infectious Aerica?!
[/list]
And what’s better than testing these new team comps against other competitive players? 

We’ve got you covered: [b]we will be hosting the second edition of the Arena Kings Community Tournament on April 26-27![/b] Join [url=https://discord.gg/nfyDKT5bcM]the game's official Discord server[/url] and stay tuned, we will share more info very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/ee61376a87b1fb2c4581506f9a336dda68bcbc57.png[/img]

See you soon in the Arena,

Team Gemelli 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]PROGRESSION & RELICS UPDATE - v0.7.4 - 18 April 2025[/h1]

[h2]PROGRESSION & UNLOCKS IN ARENA MODE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players now have access to all Champions, Personas and Relics in Arena mode. Players don’t need to play to earn XP and mastery points and eventually unlock them.
[*] Removed the tutorial missions in Arena mode, which were a bit outdated. The first 3 missions of the campaign provide a better introduction to the game’s mechanics, especially as mission #3 follows the rules of the Arena mode.
[/list]
[i]The previous progression system could be unclear and frustrating: 
[list]
[*] Players could not play a Champion that they had met and enjoyed playing in the Campaign when switching to Arena mode: they had to unlock everything again;
[*] Players had no clear idea of how long it would take them to unlock the Champions, Personas and Relics by playing Arena matches;
[*] There were few interesting team compositions available when starting to play in Arena mode, as players had access to a very limited number of Champions & Relics.
[/list]
Therefore, we decided to simply give access to all the Champions, Personas and Relics upfront in Arena mode. We see many advantages to this change:
[list]
[*] We remove the frustration related to not being able to play a cool Champion that you have met in the Campaign;
[*] Players are free to create diverse teams and experiment with synergistic Relics from the very beginning. They don’t have to grind to access the teambuilding experience;
[*] There should be more variety in match-ups;
[*] If you start playing the game and face a team that you really like (AI or PvP), you can take inspiration from it and play a similar one next game, as you have access to it. This should help discover new teams and learn all the potential cool synergies.
[/list][/i]

[h2]PRE-BUILT TEAMS IN ARENA MODE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 3 pre-built teams that new players can play in Arena mode: Sniper & Friends, Bleed Poison and Ultimate Shields! They use some of the new Relics.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/2db5bcfc0a7afdd934b81ff2bbcc0968303e71cd.jpg[/img]

[h2]RELICS CHANGES[/h2]
[i]First off, Artifacts are now called Relics! Same system, same rules, just a different name: shorter, easier to pronounce and a bit more snappy.

Our objective is to offer Relics which:
[list]
[*] Are appealing and make you excited to play them,
[*] Enable team synergies,
[*] and / or twist the gameplay of the Champion to enable them to play a different role.
[/list]
We’ve been reviewing the Relics of the first four champions of the game: Na Jima, Daerio, Jorn and Aerica with these objectives in mind. We are reworking many of them with some pretty big changes, which should open the door to many new fun team compositions![/i]

[h3]Na Jima Huntress [/h3]
[list]
[*] Celestial Great Bow: When an enemy Champion is eliminated[strike] the Celestial Great Bow gains one charge. Na Jima deals +15% damage per charge[/strike] → Na Jima and her allies gain an Impact 2 token.
[*] Echo: after casting an offensive action [strike]which hits multiple enemies[/strike], Na Jima gains an Impact token for each enemy hit.
[*] Ascending Bow: +10 damage on her primary action is now Reward #1, while her primary action pushes back enemies by 2 cells becomes Reward #2.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/f74a515c8cd04cba0f855d0ebb83d9e2bced58a5.gif[/img]
[i]We think that having two Relics that scale off the number of kills and boost Na Jima’s power was not the most interesting approach. We are keeping the Ascending Bow and reworking the Celestial Great Bow: it enables Na Jima to play more of a support / damage amplifier role.

For Ascending Bow, +10 damage on her primary action feels like a more exciting and impactful first reward, so we are swapping rewards 1 and 2.

Echo was just too weak with a too restrictive trigger condition. It will trigger much more easily, and Na Jima will still be rewarded for hitting multiple enemies.[/i]

[h3]Na Jima Skirmisher[/h3]
[list]
[*] Powerful Bow: [strike]Increases Na Jima’s range by +1[/strike] → Casting Shooting Stars (primary action) grants an Impact token to Na Jima, but no longer refunds her movement action.
[/list]
[i]We want to move away from Relics which just give +1 range or +1 movement. They don’t enable new playstyles for the bearer, they don’t synergize with other Champions and they are not very exciting to play. So we created a new version of the Powerful Bow, which greatly increases the damage potential of Na Jima Skirmisher. That being said, she loses a lot of mobility, so she will have to be properly positioned, potentially with the help of teammates like Champei, Raine or Jorn and using the rest of her kit![/i]

[h3]Daerio Renegade[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ultimate Drinker: When Daerio eliminates an enemy Champion, he gains 3 → 8 Ultimate Charges.
[*] Blood Blade: Daerio gains 25% → 30% life steal.
[/list]
[i]8 Ultimate Charges on Ultimate Drinker ?!! Yes, you read that right. The trigger condition is hard to pull off, as Daerio specifically has to slay an enemy Champion. Therefore, we want the payoff to be big enough: he gets a kill, he’s guaranteed to be able to cast his ultimate spell right away. We capped it at 8 charges instead of 9, so that he can’t chain cast his ultimate action (which costs 9 charges). We think this can create very interesting high-skill turns, with combos between his primary action, this Relic and his ultimate.

Blood Blade was just a bit too weak compared to Parrying Dagger (20 shield points per turn), so we buff it by a notch.[/i]

[h3]Daerio Duelist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Just Reward is now called Next!
[*] Pick a Card!: At the end of Daerio's turn, one of the enemy Champions is randomly chosen and becomes Daerio's Rival → this Rival also gains an Exposed token.
[*] Galeblade: When a Champion in Daerio’s team gains a Haste token, increases the value of this token by 1 → 2.
[/list]
[i]For Pick a Card!, we really like the fantasy of getting a target assigned each turn. We take it one notch further: the Rival has a clear target on their head with this damage-amplifying token. You’ll have to decide carefully which action to cast on them first to maximize the benefits of this Exposed token.

For Galeblade, we buff it to make it more exciting to play and enable hyper mobile teams running around the Arena, grabbing ultimate orbs and playing impactful turns.[/i]

[h3]Jorn Siegebreaker[/h3]
[list]
[*] [strike]Mace of Vengeance[/strike] → Conqueror’s Mace: When Jorn neutralizes an enemy Pillar, he immediately gains a Conqueror Token.
[*] Titan’s Hammer: [strike]When an enemy is eliminated, Jorn gains 30 current and maximum health points[/strike] → As long as Jorn has more health points than his target, he deals +30% increased damage.
[*] Health Points: 200 → 180.
[/list]
[i]We are introducing Conqueror’s Mace to enable Jorn to be played as a Pillar sniper, jumping around the Arena to take down pillars left undefended and capture them!

For Titan’s Hammer, we think that the previous reward was not compelling enough: gaining more HPs does not really get you closer to winning a match. Also, we wanted to create a Relic that enables to play Jorn as a Juggernaut: a massive melee Champion, who is tanky but can also deal great damage if well supported by his team.  We bring down his HPs to make sure he is not too tanky and that the Relic’s condition is not met too easily.[/i]

[h3]Jorn Predator[/h3]
[i]No change! We think that all four Relics are exciting and enable different playstyles and team compositions.[/i]

[h3]Aerica Sharpshooter[/h3]
[list]
[*] Precision Sight: [strike]Increases Aerica’s range by 1[/strike] → At the start of her turn, if Aerica has no enemy around her within a 2-cell radius, she and her allies gain a Sight token.
[*] Stunning Core: [strike]The Sentry applies Dazed and Blinded 2 to enemies they target[/strike]→ Recon-Bot also applies Blinded 1 to enemies.
[*] Slowing Ammo: Precision Shot applies Slowed 1 to its target. If Aerica has not used her movement action, it applies Slowed 2 instead → Slowed 2 and Blinded 1 instead.
[/list]
[i]For Precision Sight, same reasoning as with Na Jima’s old Powerful Bow: +1 range is not exciting and does not enable synergies. With this new Relic, Aerica has to be well positioned, far from enemies (as all good snipers should be!), in order to boost the range of her whole team.

For Stunning Core, we think that having 2 different Relics for the Sentry was not the right call. Storm Core is just too impactful and exciting to play; players who want to play around the Sentry would almost always pick it. So we changed the Relic to impact Recon-Bot and enable Aerica to play more as a hinderer.

We like the hit & run, kiting playstyle enabled by Slowing Ammo. We tune it up with Blinded 1 so that the enemy also loses range on dash / teleport spells, making it harder to catch Aerica.[/i]

[h3]Aerica Artificer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Elvish Boots : Whenever Aerica or an ally teleports through a Pillar or the Relay Beacon, they also gain 1 ultimate charge → 3 ultimate charges.
[*] [strike]Fast Deployment Network: allies can teleport and be redeployed around the Relay Beacon[/strike] → Malicious Spare Part: Vampi-Bot (primary action) also applies Infected for one round to enemy hit.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/ec6f6ae3bd87137831f94e326b10749c16b66701.gif[/img]
[i]Triggering the effect of Elvish Boots requires to invest resources, so we want the payoff to be exciting enough. We think this reinforces a potential support / placer playstyle for Aerica.

The previous version of Fast Deployment Network was complex and gave yet another role to the Relay Beacon, which has already two different use cases. We change directions and add a way to apply Infected. Infected synergizes with Aerica’s own Zap-Bot as well as all sources of pure damage : Poison (Raine, Daerio…), Bleed (Jorn, Raine, Bu Shin…) and Collision damage (Champei, Raine, Na Jima…).[/i]

[h2]RULE CHANGE[/h2]
[list]
[*] The range of a spell can no longer be decreased below its minimum range.
 -- In the previous version, if you played a spell with a 1-2 range and receive a Blind 2 token (which decreases the range of your next action by 2), the range effectively became 0 and you could not cast the spell. We think this could be very frustrating (especially in the 5th mission of the campaign) and our intention was never for the Blind token to prevent players from casting all together.
-- From now on, in this situation the range becomes 1-1 and you can always cast the spell if you’re at minimum range.
[/list]

[h2]USER EXPERIENCE IMPROVEMENTS [/h2]
[list]
[*] Added color codes for primary, secondary and ultimate actions in the description of every Relic.
[*] Added tips on the loading screen of Arena games.
[*] Added a tip explaining how pure damage works: [i]Pure damage ignores shields. Pure damage is dealt by Poison, Bleed and Collision. Some spells can deal pure damage as well.[/i]
[*] Added a tip explaining how collision damage works: [i]When a Champion is pushed against an obstacle or another Champion, they suffer 15 pure damage as collision damage.[/i]
[*] Clarified the description of the Rival status for Daerio Duelist.
[*] Added different colors on the health point bar for Healing vs. the preview of Healing.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that gave Bu Shin Shadow access to a 5th Relic (Mark of the Crown, which had no effect).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Critical Strike damage to be off by a few points in certain cases.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused matches to continue when a player would score 26 victory points through Pillar scoring. Reaching 25 points through Pillar scoring now properly grants victory.
[*] Daerio Duelist's Next! item now properly gain charges.
[/list]

notes.title: The road ahead for Skygard Arena!
notes.content:
Dear Tacticians,

First of all, we would like to thank each of you who have played Skygard Arena in early access! Overall, your feedback so far has been very enthusiastic and your suggestions very relevant. This means a lot to us and motivates us to work as hard as possible to further improve Skygard Arena! 

The goal of this post is to share with you a couple of things:
[list]
[*] What we have learnt from the early access release so far;
[*] Our development priorities and what the roadmap looks like for Skygard Arena in 2025;
[*] Some very exciting news: we have signed a partnership with a China-based publisher to help grow Skygard Arena in Asia!
[/list] 
Let’s dive in!  

[h1]LESSONS FROM EARLY ACCESS SO FAR[/h1]

As mentioned, it has been a joy to read so many positive comments after the early access release of Skygard Arena, be it on Steam, Discord or Youtube. This is our first game and a passion project that we’ve been working on for years, so hitting 88% positive reviews on Steam as we are writing these lines is truly heartwarming.

We have also been thrilled to follow a few community tournaments, with some very original strategies and very close duels!

That being said, as you might have noticed, the sales of the game have been underwhelming so far. 

We have spent a lot of time thinking about this and trying to pinpoint the reasons for the lack of significant commercial success so far. Going into every reason would take up a whole other post, but one clear conclusion stood out: just developing more content (new missions, new Chapters…) - as originally planned - is not going to significantly change the trajectory of the game.

We’ve looked at many data points and one stat that stood out is that the median playtime currently stands at 1 hour and 30 minutes, which is below our objective. To us, this means that at the moment the first 2 hours of the game are not compelling enough to hook most of the players into playing further. This contrasts starkly with the feedback we get from players who have put 8+ hours into the game: they really like the challenge from the later part of the campaign and all the strategic possibilities offered by the game. They often end up playing over 20 hours, including in PvP.

We have also observed that 70% of Skygard Arena players only play the single-player campaign, 5% of players only play in multiplayer and 25% of players play both modes.

Based on these lessons, we have decided to focus on 3 core objectives: 
[olist]
[*] Improve the first playthrough of the Campaign (especially the first 2 hours), across all dimensions: gameplay / missions, story / writing and progression;
[*] Add replayability to the single-player PvE Campaign, through the upcoming Quests Update ;
[*] Reach more players to make the multiplayer experience more compelling, by translating the game in more languages and executing a better marketing campaign for the 1.0 release later this year.
[/olist] 
In any case, rest assured: we are absolutely not giving up on Skygard Arena and we will do our best to create the best possible game and reach as many players as possible!

[h1]2025 ROADMAP[/h1]

Based on the objectives mentioned above, and taking into account our current resources in a tight funding environment for game studios, we have landed on the following development roadmap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/c3f7eba62d44fc2144d2f5857fc84810d9f0cc02.png[/img]

[h2]Campaign & Story Update (this week!)[/h2]

Our main goal for this update is to [b]improve the quality of the first playthrough of the campaign, especially the first 2 hours.[/b]

To this end, we have changed the level design of several missions in the first half of the campaign and merged some tutorials. This way, we have both improved the early missions and shortened the time before players get to the more spicy missions (boss fights for instance!), which should lead to a more interesting campaign.

We have also adjusted the rewards given after each mission. Our goal is to give more synergistic Personas and Artefacts early on, to offer interesting teambuilding options to players throughout the campaign.

Finally, we have reworked the story and the dialogues inside the game, with the following objectives in mind:
[list]
[*] Share more information about the [b]backstory[/b] of each Champion, their beliefs and their motivations, especially when chatting with them in the camp;
[*] Make the overall story [b]easier to follow[/b] and remove some inconsistencies;
[*] Provide a [b]proper conclusion[/b] at the end of the 3rd chapter of the campaign.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this revamped story and welcome your feedback!

As usual, the update also comes with a bunch of visual improvements, quality of life upgrades and bug fixes. The full patch notes will be published on Thursday when the update goes live. Stay tuned!

[h2]Quests Update (April ‘25)[/h2]

Have you ever enjoyed a mission so much that you wish you could play it again with slightly different conditions and a higher difficulty? 

Well… we’ve got you covered!

This update - planned for April - will add [b]Quests[/b] to the PvE Campaign. Quests will be[b] mission-specific challenges[/b] that will put your tactical skills to the test: defeating a boss without losing a single member of your team, completing a mission with / without a specific Champion or Artifact, or before a certain turn limit… 

If you think of mission-specific challenges that would be cool, feel free to drop your idea in the comments or on our Discord server!

 And we promise you… achieving all the quests to 100% the game won’t be an easy feat ;)  

[h2]Localization Update (June ‘25)[/h2]

We believe adding more languages to the game is critical to reach a more global and larger audience. To this end, we will be adding [b]Chinese and Japanese localization[/b] to the game, with potentially other languages on top. 

[h2]1.0 release (September ‘25) [/h2]

To celebrate the global launch, players will be able to battle in [b]a new PvP Arena[/b] and [b]a new Champion[/b] will join the fray! This will bring the game’s content to 10 Champions, 20 Personas, 80 spells and 80 artifacts, allowing for new team compositions and even more combos.

If you have played the Campaign, you might have an idea of who that mighty new Champion might be…

Finally, we plan to make balancing changes throughout the year and to organize PvP community tournaments at various points during the year, including on the back of the 1.0 launch. 

[h1]PUBLISHING PARTNERSHIP FOR CHINA & JAPAN[/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that [b]we have signed an agreement with SpaceJazz Games for them to publish Skygard Arena in China & Japan![/b]

SpaceJazz Games is a Shanghai-based indie publisher and marketing specialist. They have a strong track record of marketing games in China, having worked on titles such as Temtem: Swarm and Citadelum. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/4ef4c3ca2502dd9363d66245c6d94caea925ec80.png[/img]

SpaceJazz Games will handle localization of the game in Chinese and Japanese as well as local marketing activities to reach new players in these countries.

We are super excited about this partnership and thrilled to be able to share Skygard Arena with many players around the world!

We hope this post provides a good overview of where we want to go with Skygard Arena and why. Any question, let us know! 

Thank you for your support,

See you in the Arena,

The Gemelli Games Team

notes.title: The Christmas Update is here!
notes.content:
Dear Tacticians, 

It’s Christmas season and we have our first Major Update for you - full of presents!

We are adding [b]a new mission in the campaign[/b] and introducing a [b]new map for PvP battles[/b].

We are also implementing [b]several changes to the spells and artifacts of some of the Champions[/b], with the objective to maximize the number of fun and powerful team compositions. To that end, we are tuning down the power of some Champions that were too strong and very often used (Bu Shin Thunder…), buffing some less powerful Champions (Na Jima...) and making some changes to less picked Artifacts to make them more exciting to play.  

Finally, we are fixing some bugs that you found (thank you for your vigilance and your reports!) and improving the user experience in multiple places.

Please find below the full list of changes. And since Christmas is coming… Skygard Arena will be discounted during the Steam Winter Sale! You can grab the game on sale if you have not tried it yet.

We wish you a very happy festive season and we will see you in the Arena!

The Gemelli Games Team

------

[h1]CAMPAIGN[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mission #16 has arrived in game! No spoilers - just brace yourself for an epic boss fight in which you will need to use your tactical skills at your best.
[/list]

[h1]ARENA MODE[/h1]
[list]
[*] New map for PvP matches: the Ice Walls! Get ready for some snowy skirmishes in the cold.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/234f6f07c53f3ffb1f7c1006b2f7618a3fa74602.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284607/c412ccfadd523368af5f7b92ff675a4b702ac429.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHAMPIONS & ARTIFACTS CHANGES [/h1]

[h3]Na Jima[/h3]
[i]The data shows that she is currently struggling in PvP matches. We want her to be able to hunt down enemy Champions, so we are increasing her mobility to put it on par with most Champions.[/i]
[list]
[*] [b]Movement: 2 cells -> 3 cells[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Aerica - Sharpshooter[/h3]
[i]She fulfills very well her role as one of the strongest single-target damage dealers of the game. Her first Artifact, Precision Sight, is overwhelmingly used. We are buffing one of her other Artifacts to open more viable options.[/i]
[list]
[*] Slowing Ammunition (Artifact):  If Aerica has not used her movement action this turn, Aimed Shot applies Slowed II to the target → [b]Aimed Shot applies Slowed I to the target.[/b] If Aerica has not used her movement action this turn, applies Slowed II instead.
[/list]

[h3]Aerica - Artificer[/h3]
[i]We are reworking one of her less-picked Artifacts to center her gameplay around giving ultimate charges to allies.[/i]
[list]
[*] Elvish Boots (Artifact): +1 Movement → [b]Whenever Aerica or an ally teleports through a Pillar or the Relay Beacon, they also gain 1 ultimate charge.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Jorn - Predator[/h3]
[i]We are adding bonus damage on the critical strike of his primary action, to put it on par with most primary actions.[/i]
[list]
[*] Wild Charge (Primary Action): [b]critical strikes now deal 50% more damage[/b], on top of applying Bleed 3.
[/list]

[h3]Daerio - Renegade[/h3]
[i]We are increasing the payoff on his ultimate if you are able to hit Pillars on top of Champions. We are simplifying the Ultimate Drinker artifact to make it more consistently powerful. We are also introducing a new Artifact with Lifesteal to offer more diverse playstyles![/i]
[list]
[*] Checkmate (Ultimate Action): deals an extra 20 damage for each champion hit after the first → deals an extra 20 damage for each champion [b]and Pillar[/b] hit after the first.
[*] Ultimate Drinker (Artifact): Whenever Daerio slays a Champion, he gains as many ultimate charges as this champion has (minimum 1) → he gains [b]3 ultimate charges[/b].
[*] The Charged Blade Artifact is replaced by [b]Blood Blade: When Daerio deals damage, he heals himself for 25% of damage dealt.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Daerio - Duelist [/h3]
[i]This Persona could feel a bit clunky to use and underpowered, especially because the Rival effect would take one turn to be applied. We are reworking the main spells and some artifacts to make Daerio Duelist more fun and viable![/i]
[list]
[*] Ballestra (Primary Action) - reworked:  
-- Daerio lunges toward target enemy, then deals 35 damage. [b]The target immediately becomes Daerio's Rival.
-- If the target was already Daerio's Rival, deals a Critical Strike.
-- Critical Strike: deals 50% more damage and steals 2 ultimate charges from target[/b].
[*] Elvish Agility (Secondary Action) - reworked:  
-- Grants the Ethereal and Haste I tokens to Daerio.
-- Ethereal token (reworked): The next Movement action can go across obstacles. It does not trigger surveillance effects.
[*] Duelist’s Dance (Secondary Action): Deals [b]20→ 15[/b] damage to target enemy. If the target is Daerio’s Rival, Daerio gains Barrier and Riposte tokens.
-- Riposte Token (from Duelist’s Dance): counter-attack next offensive enemy action received, dealing [b]25 → 20 [/b]damage.
[*] The Swift Dagger Artifact is replaced by the [b] new Pick a Card! Artifact: 
-- At the end of Daerio's turn, one of the enemy Champions is randomly chosen and becomes Daerio's Rival. [/b]
[*] Galeblade (Artifact): Whenever [b]Daerio[/b] gains Haste, this token’s level is increased by [b]2[/b] → Whenever [b]a Champion in your team[/b] gains a Haste token, the value of this token is increased by [b]1[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Champei - Earth Avatar [/h3]
[i]We are adding some nice side effects to some of her Artifacts to increase the number of interesting Artifact picks. [/i]
[list]
[*] Shocking Gong (Artifact): When an enemy receives collision damage, applies Slowed I to them → applies Slowed I to them and [b]gives Celerity I to Champei[/b].
[*] Rupturing Gong (Artifact): When an enemy receives collision damage, applies Bleed II to them → applies Bleed II to them and [b]gives Regeneration I to Champei[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Raine - Poison Witch[/h3]
[i]We are making her movement and positioning spells more flexible to allow for more combos with her allies.[/i]
[list]
[*] Bramble Wave (Secondary Action): Pushes [b]enemies[/b] back 2 cells in a 2-cell long cone and applies Poison 2 → Pushes [b]all units[/b] back 2 cells in a 2-cell long cone. Applies Poison 2 to all enemies targeted. 
[*] Beguiling Spores (Secondary Action): Attracts [b]target enemy[/b] by 3 cells towards Raine and applies Poison 2 → Attracts [b]target unit[/b] by 3 cells toward Raine. If they are an enemy, applies Poison 2 to them.
[/list]

[h3]Vallya - Vanguard[/h3]
[i]We are really happy with her spells and her versatility! That being said, being able to cast Valorous Intervention without line of sight does not seem very healthy : it makes it too easy to use, as one does not need to make smart positioning decisions to be able to cast the spell.[/i]
[list]
[*] Valorous Intervention (Secondary Action) : can be cast without line of sight → [b]requires line of sight to be cast[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Bu Shin - Thunder Warrior[/h3]
[i]The terror of the Arena! We are very happy with the core gameplay of his kit, as it allows for truly crazy turns with multiple actions and movements. That being said, he has simply too much mobility and damage compared to other Champions, so we are tuning down these aspects.
We are also nerfing his most used Artifact and buffing another one, again to try and make multiple Artifact picks viable.[/i]
[list]
[*] Eye of the Storm (Secondary Action): [b]no longer grants another movement action[/b].
[*] Thunderstorm (Ultimate Action) : [b]deals 10 → 8 damage per cell travelled[/b].
[*] Lightstealer (Artifact): Whenever Bu Shin neutralizes an Enemy Pillar, he gains [b]3 → 2 Ultimate Charges[/b].
[*] Unending Tempest (Artifact): Bu Shin's health points are reduced by [b]50% → 25%[/b], but Bu Shin ignores the one-turn penalty before redeployment when he is eliminated.
[/list]


[h1]OVERALL GAMEPLAY CHANGES [/h1]
[list]
[*] If a Champion has a Focus token and meets the condition for their primary action to deal a Critical Strike (e.g., Vallya Vanguard being under the effect of a Protection), the Focus token will no longer be consumed. 
[/list]


[h1]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added visual effects on Pillars at the end of a game in Arena mode - check them out!
[*] Improved the visual effect of Bu Shin’s Thunderstorm ultimate in arenas with a night atmosphere.
[/list]

[h1]UI / UX IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] The description of Bu Shin’s Tunderstorm spell now displays Bu Shin’s current number of ultimate charges.
[*] Improved the buttons to capture a Pillar or teleport through a Pillar and their animations.
[*] In the Campaign mode, loading screens now display a gameplay tip.
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Casting Destroyer Ammo when Aerica is under Soul Bound no longer causes the game to freeze.
